meta.titre: Territorial Administration of Cameroon: regions, divisions, subdivisions and councils
meta.sous_theme: Administrative units, their heads and the role of councils

source.epreuve_titre: GCE O/L Citizenship Education past paper (Cameroon)

sections.contenu_markdown: When a family in a village needs a birth certificate, it goes to the civil status office of the council. When a public event has to be authorised or a dispute settled, an administrative officer is involved. These services reach people through a chain of units that runs from the Region down to the subdivision. At the GCE you are asked to name the units, to say who heads each one, to place the regions on a table or map and to explain what councils do. These are questions that can be answered with a few well-learned facts.

items: Cameroon is divided into ten regions.
Administration means organising and running the affairs of a country or an area.
The President of the Republic is the head of state.

sections.titre: How Cameroon is divided and governed locally
sections.contenu_markdown:
### Meaning
**Territorial administration** is the way the State divides the national territory into units and places officers in charge of them to apply the laws, keep public order and bring public services close to the people.

### The administrative units, from the largest to the smallest
| Unit | Head |
|---|---|
| Region | Governor |
| Division | Senior Divisional Officer (SDO) |
| Subdivision | Divisional Officer (DO) |

The **Region** is the largest administrative unit. Governors, SDOs and DOs are appointed by the President of the Republic. They represent the State, report to the authority above them and are helped by other senior officers.

### The ten regions and their capitals
| Region | Capital | Region | Capital |
|---|---|---|---|
| Adamawa | Ngaoundere | North | Garoua |
| Centre | Yaounde | North West | Bamenda |
| East | Bertoua | South | Ebolowa |
| Far North | Maroua | South West | Buea |
| Littoral | Douala | West | Bafoussam |

### What administrative officers do
They keep law and order, coordinate the work of State services in their unit, carry out government policy, supervise local authorities and settle disputes peacefully before they grow.

### Decentralisation and councils
The Constitution describes Cameroon as a decentralised unitary State. **Regions and councils** are the local authorities. A council is led by a mayor and its councillors are elected by the citizens. Councils manage local affairs such as markets, civil status records, local roads and public hygiene. Councils work under the supervision of the State.

### Why units exist
Dividing the country brings government near to the people, makes it easier to deliver services and lets local people take part in running their own affairs.

variantes.quand_utiliser: When the question asks who heads a unit
variantes.contenu_markdown: Learn the chain in order: Region and Governor, Division and Senior Divisional Officer, Subdivision and Divisional Officer, and, for the local authority, council and mayor. The smaller the unit, the lower in the chain.

variantes.quand_utiliser: When the question asks for a condition needed before a unit is created
variantes.contenu_markdown: Give a general factor with a short reason, such as a sufficient population to justify services, a suitable size of the area, or enough economic activity and facilities to run the unit. One clear criterion with its reason earns the mark.

variantes.quand_utiliser: When the question asks you to distinguish between an officer and a council
variantes.contenu_markdown: A Governor, SDO or DO is appointed by the President and represents the State. A council is a local authority led by a mayor with elected councillors, and it manages local affairs. One is about State authority, the other about local self-management.

sections.enonce_markdown: Distinguish between the work of a Divisional Officer and that of a mayor. (6 marks)

etapes.action: Identify the two persons and the idea of the question.
etapes.justification: Distinguish means to show how two things differ, so both must be treated, point by point.
etapes.resultat_markdown: Divisional Officer: head of a subdivision. Mayor: head of a council.

etapes.action: Write the first difference: how they come to office.
etapes.justification: Origin of authority is a clear point of contrast.
etapes.resultat_markdown: A Divisional Officer is appointed by the President of the Republic. A mayor leads a council whose councillors are elected by citizens.

etapes.action: Write the second difference: who they represent.
etapes.justification: This shows the difference between State administration and local self-management.
etapes.resultat_markdown: The Divisional Officer represents the State in the subdivision. The mayor manages the affairs of the local community.

etapes.action: Write the third difference: the main tasks.
etapes.resultat_markdown: The Divisional Officer keeps law and order, coordinates State services and supervises local authorities. The mayor's council manages markets, local roads, civil status records and hygiene.

sections.conclusion_markdown: Model answer: A Divisional Officer and a mayor do not do the same work. First, a Divisional Officer is appointed by the President of the Republic, while a mayor heads a council whose councillors are elected by the people. Second, the Divisional Officer represents the State in the subdivision, whereas the mayor manages the affairs of the local community. Third, the Divisional Officer keeps law and order and coordinates State services, whereas the council looks after local needs such as markets, local roads, civil status records and public hygiene.

items.erreur_markdown: "The SDO is the head of a region."
items.pourquoi_faux: The SDO heads a division. The head of a region is the Governor.
items.correction_markdown: Governor for the Region, SDO for the Division, DO for the Subdivision.

items.erreur_markdown: "The division is the largest administrative unit."
items.pourquoi_faux: The order from the largest to the smallest is Region, Division, Subdivision. The Region is the largest.
items.correction_markdown: Write: the Region is the largest administrative unit in Cameroon.

items.erreur_markdown: "A council and a division are the same thing."
items.pourquoi_faux: A division is a State administrative unit under an appointed officer. A council is a local authority led by a mayor with elected councillors.
items.correction_markdown: Use two different words and explain the difference: administrative unit for the division, local authority for the council.

items.pourquoi_faux: Cameroon is divided into ten regions.
items.correction_markdown: Learn the ten names and their capitals as a list.

items.erreur_markdown: "Yaounde is the capital of the Littoral Region."
items.pourquoi_faux: Yaounde is the capital of the Centre Region. The capital of the Littoral Region is Douala.
items.correction_markdown: Match the capitals with the regions by learning the table in pairs.

items.enonce_markdown: (a) Name the head of (i) a Region, (ii) a Division, (iii) a Subdivision. (b) Which of the three units is the largest?
items.solution_markdown: (a) (i) The Governor. (ii) The Senior Divisional Officer. (iii) The Divisional Officer. (b) The **Region**. Award one mark for each head and one for the unit.

items.enonce_markdown: State the Region whose capital is (i) Bamenda, (ii) Buea, (iii) Bertoua, (iv) Maroua.
items.solution_markdown: (i) **North West**. (ii) **South West**. (iii) **East**. (iv) **Far North**. Award one mark for each correct pair.

items.enonce_markdown: The people of a growing area ask the State to create a new subdivision. (a) Explain two factors that the authorities may consider before taking a decision. (b) Describe two ways in which the people may benefit.
items.solution_markdown: (a) Any two with a reason: the number of inhabitants, because a unit needs enough people to justify its services; the size and geography of the area, because officers must be able to reach all the villages; the economic activity, because the unit needs resources and facilities to function. (b) Any two: public services such as an administrative office, civil status records and security come nearer to the people; less travel and expense to deal with the administration; local development projects are easier to organise; local people can take part in running their own affairs. Award a mark for each factor with its reason and a mark for each benefit explained.

items_markdown: Territorial administration divides the country into units led by officers appointed by the President: the Governor for the Region, the SDO for the Division and the DO for the Subdivision.
The Region is the largest unit. Cameroon has ten regions, each with a capital.
Administrative officers keep law and order, coordinate State services, carry out government policy and supervise local authorities.
Regions and councils are the local authorities of a decentralised State. Councils are led by mayors and manage local affairs.
Distinguish with points: appointed officer and State representative against elected council and local affairs.
